about: Split calls from the first look of wave 24.

listings.note: Two loops 800 m apart on either side of the lake (001 to 024 west, 025 to 051 northeast), with the group sites between.
Three clusters strung along a peninsula over 1.2 km: 01 to 08 at the north end, 09 to 18 in the middle, 19 to 64 at the south end.
Four places over 1.5 km: the lettered sites A to X on the west, 69 to 86 beside them, 01 to 55 on the point, and P01 to P16 across the bay to the northeast.
